title: Outcome-Aware Agents: When Does Causal Structure Help a Forward Model Foresee the Consequences of Actions?
abstract: arXiv:2610.34385v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agents that act on real systems should predict what their actions will cause before acting. We study when causal structure helps a learned forward model do this, using a planner that rejects candidate actions whose simulated multi-step outcome is unsafe, in synthetic structural causal models where the true consequences are known. We compare the Action-Conditioned Latent Structural Causal Model (AC-LSCM: per-factor mechanisms over a learned sparse graph, actions as do-interventions) with three unstructured forward models on seven random graphs with 10 or 20 variables, a task configured by a fixed rule, and two controls: a do-wrapper that gives every model the same action semantics, and counterfactual data given to all models or to none. When its factors are the observed variables, AC-LSCM recovers the true graph exactly on every 10-variable graph and has lower three-step prediction error than every baseline in all 396 paired comparisons

translated_title: 结果感知智能体：因果结构何时能帮助前向模型预见行动的后果？
translated_abstract: 作用于真实系统的智能体应当在行动之前预测其行动将产生什么后果。我们研究因果结构何时能帮助学习得到的前向模型实现这一点，在真实后果已知的合成结构因果模型中，使用一个规划器来拒绝那些模拟多步结果不安全的候选动作。我们将动作条件化潜在结构因果模型（AC-LSCM：在学习到的稀疏图上为每个因子建模机制，动作作为do干预）与三个非结构化前向模型进行比较，实验在七个包含10或20个变量的随机图上进行，任务由固定规则配置，并设置两个对照实验：一个为所有模型提供相同动作语义的do包装器，以及给所有模型提供或不提供反事实数据。当其因子为观测变量时，AC-LSCM在每一个10变量图上都能精确恢复真实因果图，并且在全部396组配对比较中，其三步预测误差均低于所有基线模型。
tldr: 本研究提出动作条件化潜在结构因果模型（AC-LSCM），证明因果结构能显著提升前向模型预测行动后果的能力——在10变量图上可精确恢复真实因果图，且三步预测误差在全部396组配对比较中均优于非结构化基线模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Action-Conditioned Latent Structural Causal Model (AC-LSCM), demonstrating that causal structure significantly improves a forward model's ability to foresee action consequences—exactly recovering true causal graphs on 10-variable settings and achieving lower three-step prediction error than all unstructured baselines in all 396 paired comparisons.
